title: Low power: a solar panel has failed
summary: During imaging the battery is draining faster than it should. Find out why and save the satellite.
goals: Read power telemetry: generation, load, net power
Understand the trade-off between pointing the camera and pointing the arrays
Shed load to protect the battery
situation: The satellite is imaging in NADIR mode with the camera on. The low-power rule has been disabled for a software update, so nothing will protect the battery automatically. The instructor console shows the training contact aid is on: you can command at any time.

steps.text: Switch the camera off (pl.main OFF) to reduce the load.
steps.hint: Power telemetry: 'Total load'. The camera is the biggest consumer.

steps.text: Point the arrays at the Sun: ADCS MODE SUNSAFE.
steps.hint: In NADIR the arrays face the Sun only part of the orbit. One panel shows 0 W in the Power group - that is the failed one.

steps.text: Confirm the battery is charging again.

steps.hint: Use time warp. Eclipses pause charging.

failText: The battery dropped below 10% and the satellite entered safe mode.
successText: Battery recovered. Lesson: when generation drops, shed load and point the arrays at the Sun first; investigate later.
